exposure: Women with typical connective tissue disease
cohort: 53 women aged 16-45 years with a history of primary CAD
finding: The risk of recurrent CAD may not be greatly increased with pregnancies starting at least 12 months after CAD in women without typical connective tissue disease.
mod_finding: All 13 pregnancies and puerperia went without recurrent CADs or cerebrovascular events, including vaginal delivery (n = 6) and caesarean section (n = 7).
